question: Which bodily parts are assigned to specific seed powers for protection?
premises: The speech-seed is invoked to protect the head.
The queen of desire is invoked to protect the face.
Different powers guard different body parts.
inference: The speech-seed protects the head and the queen of desire protects the face.
uncertainties: am: form interpreted as genitive of first person
plain_english: May the speech-seed protect my head, and may the queen of desire protect my face.
